speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I will be Dr. Agent, and I need to examine a specific lesion you have. How long has this spot been present, and have you noticed any changes in its size, color, or shape recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penile and Digit)

Given your history of heavy smoking, African origin, and non-healing lesions on both the penis and a finger despite previous treatments, I am highly concerned for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. I need to confirm the location and extent of these lesions; can you describe the appearance of the lesion on your finger compared to the one on your penis?
